# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. It lands the entire v4 breaking-change set — legacy SKPaint text/font APIs become compile errors, Vulkan requires 1.1, and several type and struct signatures changed. The release also delivers variable font shaping, animated WebP encoding, Linux Bionic native assets, and a reworked singleton lifecycle.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pre-v4 SKPaint text/font APIs are now compile errors** — The text and font state members on SKPaint obsoleted in v3 (Typeface, TextSize, TextSkewX, etc.) are promoted to compile-time errors. Move text configuration onto SKFont and pass it to the drawing methods. Remove all references to SKPaint's font/text properties; the compiler will point out every site that needs updating. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **SKFont and SKPaint default typeface is no longer null** — new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty instead of resolving lazily at draw time — MeasureText returns 0 and nothing draws if you omit the typeface. new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default (non-null). Replace == null checks with .IsEmpty and construct fonts with an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default).
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 devices** — Skia m132+ requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance or leaving GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion at 0 now calls SK_ABORT and terminates the process — it is not catchable. Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and MaxAPIVersion to VK_API_VERSION_1_1 (0x00401000). Devices that cannot reach 1.1 must fall back to the raster backend. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative fields removed** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed from GRVkBackendContextNative. Use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in place of fFeatures. Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the context struct.
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo type changed; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value equality** — The property type changed from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable and its == / != operators are removed. Update struct references and remove equality comparisons on this type.

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m148** — The bundled Skia engine advances through milestones m132, m133, m147, and m148, bringing upstream rendering improvements, bug fixes, and the new GPU API prerequisites that enable Graphite in future releases. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Upstream m147 stability fixes merged** — Two cherry-pick syncs from the chrome/m147 branch apply additional engine-level stability and correctness fixes on top of the milestone bump. ([#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable font support in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp** — Consumers can now load and use variable fonts: set axis values on SKTypeface, enumerate font axes, and use OpenType variable shaping through HarfBuzzSharp. Color font palette access is also exposed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744), [#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **Animated WebP encoding via SKWebpEncoder** — SKWebpEncoder gains animated WebP output: encode a sequence of frames into a single .webp file with per-frame timing, quality, and loop-count control. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Zero-copy stream-to-data conversion with SKStream.GetData()** — SKStream.GetData() returns the underlying SKData without copying when the stream already wraps a data object, and falls back to a buffered read otherwise — a useful optimisation for pipeline steps that work directly with SKData. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **HBColor struct for color palette values** — A new HBColor value type properly wraps hb_color_t, replacing the previous uint representation and giving color palette API a typed, documented surface. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **SKSamplingOptions added to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface** — Overloads of DrawSurface now accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter, giving callers control over the interpolation filter used when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Missing API wrappers and naming corrections** — Several previously unreachable native entry points are now wrapped, and a number of binding names that violated the SkiaSharp naming convention are corrected. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrected** — GetPixelSpan used Height instead of Width for the x-axis offset, and did not use RowBytes for stride — both are now fixed, preventing silent pixel-data corruption when accessing non-square or padded bitmaps. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first** — A native use-after-free in the SKPath finalizer triggered when the GC collected SKPathBuilder before SKPath. The object graph is now rooted correctly. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI failed to locate the WinUI Projection DLL under .NET 9 due to a path resolution change. The lookup is now corrected. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Apple platform TFM alignment** — Library TFMs are set to version 26.0 and app TFMs use the unversioned form, matching Apple's SDK conventions and fixing spurious TFM mismatches. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **Android SKGLView stops rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar** — The OpenGL view surface was not correctly re-established after a MAUI TabBar navigation away and back. The surface lifecycle is now handled correctly. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — The lifetime management of SkiaSharp singleton objects (font managers, image filters, etc.) is redesigned to be deterministic and finalizer-safe, eliminating a class of use-after-free that appeared under GC pressure. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi constructor** — The check that validates the native library version is now in the SkiaApi type constructor rather than a ModuleInitializer, making the error easier to surface and diagnose at startup. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic native assets added** — Pre-built native libraries are now shipped for Linux Bionic (Android-derived userspace), enabling SkiaSharp on non-Android systems that use the Bionic C library. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support** — The Tizen platform now builds and ships native libraries for both x64 and arm64 architectures, completing Tizen multi-architecture coverage. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3672](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3672))
- **WASM: pre-.NET 8 Emscripten targets dropped** — Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes are removed. .NET 8+ (Emscripten 3.1.34+) remains fully supported. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Native dependency refreshes** — Bundled native libraries are updated: expat to 2.8.1, libexpat to 2.7.5, libpng to 1.6.58, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds variable font shaping, an HBColor value type for color palette access, and enables the HarfBuzz binding on new platforms including Linux Bionic and Tizen arm64/x64.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 promoted the remaining pre-v4 SKPaint text/font obsoletes to compile errors, trimmed obsolete enums from the ref assembly, moved the native-compat gate to the SkiaApi constructor, updated expat to 2.8.1, and merged the final Skia m148 stability fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Preview 3 added HBColor, SKStream.GetData(), missing API wrappers, updated libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, dropped pre-.NET 8 WASM targets, and refreshed the .NET SDK.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

## Preview 2 (May 6, 2026)

Preview 2 delivered animated WebP encoding, the SKPath finalizer fix, GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrections, and Apple platform TFM alignment.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the v4 line from v3.119.4, introducing variable fonts, color font palettes, Skia milestone advancement through m148, the singleton lifecycle rework, Linux Bionic native assets, Tizen arm64/x64 support, and native dependency refreshes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v3.119.4...v4.147.0-preview.1.1)
